title: An unsigned adviser to Hetman Sieniawski, c. 1707 (DECODE R7475)

steps.what: DECODE metadata for R7460-R7507 by API; 130 images of R7462-R7507 with the session cookie; no key or decryption file on any record.

Subagents transcribed the unprinted Sieniawski pieces with their interlinear decipherments: R7475 (alphabetical homophonic table rebuilt from the gloss), R7476 and R7484-R7485 (Chomentowski's 3-digit syllabary, syllabary.tsv), R7481-R7482 (key B).

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 from sieniawski1708 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the Vienna-Schenck letters are schenck1706; the Sieniawski letters are one entry per key: key A (sieniawski1708), key B (turculet1709), the R7475 table (r7475), the Chomentowski syllabary (chomentowski1713).
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): R7475.txt (numbers with the interlinear gloss); gloss lines copied verbatim to texts/R7475_decryption.md

Verification 3 (v3_below_b): flagged at 0.34 on R7475_decryption.md (gloss lines with notes, mid-word line breaks). Wrote texts/R7475_reading.md, word-divided from the contemporary gloss, holes marked: 0.95 explicit holes. Kept read.

Brice Dudout (Claude Opus 5.5): independent decoder (verify_dudout_20261114.py) taking the majority value of each number in R7475_key.tsv and decoding the 79 cipher lines of R7475.txt: 2441 legible numbers plus 3 blots = 2444, as in the count; decoded letters aligned with the interlinear gloss (clear words and notes removed): 2374 of 2443 agree (97.2%). The 69 differing letters are the conflicts and slips listed at the end of R7475.txt (50 for z, 47 for p, 57 for w, 22 for d/k/z, blots), clear words not quoted in the cipher line (super, L20) and the code group 600. No majority value is contradicted. README read bar recount on texts/R7475_reading.md: 0.968 over 449 words, as recorded. DECODE images not re-read.

Project check of PR #565 (Brice Dudout): his independent decoder re-run (2441 legible numbers, 2374 of 2443 decoded letters agree with the gloss, 97.2%); v10_relabel.measure 0.968 over 449 words, as recorded. DECODE images not fetched.

texts.label: R7475, pp. 29-30, c. 1707
texts.summary: An unsigned, undated Polish letter (with Latin phrases) to Grand Crown Hetman Adam Mikołaj Sieniawski from an adviser in his camp, most likely 1707: he warns against the Bishop of Chełmno's (Teodor Potocki's) mediation and Stanisław Leszczyński's treaty offers, and advises waiting for the outcome of the Swedish march on Moscow and concluding only together with all.

reading_review.note: v3 check 23 Oct 2026: the sweep scored texts/R7475_decryption.md, the glossator's letter-by-letter lines with the cipher's line breaks, few word divisions and the transcriber's bracketed notes (0.34). The reading was written out from it (texts/R7475_reading.md: words joined across line ends and divided, the gloss's spelling kept, the figures followed where the notes show the gloss slipping, unread and partial words as holes): 0.95 on explicit holes, hole rate 0.032 (plain not measurable: no Polish word list). Rests on the contemporary interlinear decipherment on the page.
